title: Use one explicitly marked disposable pi-chrome workspace
description: Preflight for all managed pi-web QA cases. The workspace is created and marked outside the browser case with exact recorded IDs; this case only selects and verifies it.

requires.markedWorkspace: A disposable workspace is pre-created and marked by the operator with agentUiVersion=pi-web-ui-v1
requires.cleanup: The selected workspace ID and every created session ID are recorded before cleanup; never substitute the HubSpot source ID

steps.expected: The selected record in the authenticated GET /api/workspaces response has agentUiVersion exactly pi-web-ui-v1; if not, stop as blocked.
